requests.description: Gets the health check values for an API if it is being recorded
requests.name: GET /tyk/health/

requests.description: Gets a list of *key* IDs (will only work with non-hashed installations)
requests.name: GET /tyk/keys/

requests.description: Create a new *API token* with the *session object* defined in the body
requests.name: POST /tyk/keys/create

requests.description: Remove this *API token* from the gateway, this will completely destroy the token and metadata associated with the token and instantly stop access from being granted
requests.name: DELETE /tyk/keys/{keyId}
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Add a pre-specified *API token* with the *session object* defined in the body, this operatin creates a custom token that dsoes not use the gateway naming convention for tokens
requests.name: POST /tyk/keys/{keyId}
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Update an *API token* with the *session object* defined in the body, this operatin overwrites the existing object
requests.name: PUT /tyk/keys/{keyId}
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: The final request from an authorising party for a redirect URI during the Tyk OAuth flow
requests.name: POST /tyk/oauth/authorize-client/

requests.description: Get a list of OAuth clients bound to this back end
requests.name: GET /tyk/oauth/clients/{apiId}
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.name: DELETE /tyk/oauth/clients/{apiId}/{clientId}
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.name: DELETE /tyk/oauth/refresh/{keyId}
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values
